art_note: Mockups look composited with generic lighting, lacking true high-end campaign atmosphere.
desc_en: Sculpted silhouette defined by an all-over floral motif. This short-sleeve crew neck bodysuit contours the body precisely, offering a refined and versatile aesthetic. Crafted from a soft-touch stretch fabric, it features a snap-button closure at the base for seamless functionality. An essential piece designed to transition effortlessly from evening events to daily refinement. Available made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Silueta esculpida con delicado motivo floral integral. Este body de manga corta y cuello redondo se adapta con precisión a la línea corporal, ofreciendo una estética depurada y versátil. Confeccionado en tejido elástico de tacto suave, incorpora cierre inferior con botones a presión para mayor funcionalidad. Una pieza esencial para transicionar sin esfuerzo entre ocasiones formales y estilismos cotidianos. Disponible bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Composition: polyester and spandex
· Short sleeve and crew neck design
· 180GSM all-over print
· Snap-button closure at the bottom
· Care instructions: hand wash or machine wash with cold water, do not bleach, tumble dry low, do not iron, do not dry clean
· Made to order with worldwide shipping
